papers.title: The Pricing of Options and Corporate Liabilities
papers.description: The original Black-Scholes paper that revolutionized options pricing.
papers.whyRead: Foundation of modern derivatives pricing. Every quant should understand this.

papers.title: Theory of Rational Option Pricing
papers.description: Merton's extension of Black-Scholes with continuous-time portfolio theory.
papers.whyRead: Extends Black-Scholes, introduces Merton's portfolio problem.

papers.title: Portfolio Selection
papers.description: The original paper on mean-variance portfolio optimization.
papers.whyRead: Foundation of modern portfolio theory. Won Nobel Prize.

papers.title: Common Risk Factors in the Returns on Stocks and Bonds
papers.description: The Fama-French three-factor model: market, size, value.
papers.whyRead: Most cited finance paper. Understanding factors is essential for quant work.

papers.title: A Five-Factor Asset Pricing Model
papers.description: Extended five-factor model adding profitability and investment factors.
papers.whyRead: Modern factor model used by institutional investors worldwide.

papers.title: High-Frequency Trading in a Limit Order Book
papers.description: Optimal market making strategy using stochastic control.
papers.whyRead: The go-to paper for market making. Used by real market makers.

papers.title: A New Interpretation of Information Rate
papers.description: The Kelly criterion for optimal bet sizing.
papers.whyRead: Optimal position sizing. Used by traders and gamblers alike.

papers.title: The 10 Reasons Most Machine Learning Funds Fail
papers.description: Common pitfalls in ML-based trading strategies.
papers.whyRead: Avoid the mistakes that kill most ML trading strategies.

papers.title: A Conceptual Introduction to Hamiltonian Monte Carlo
papers.description: HMC for Bayesian inference in financial models.
papers.whyRead: Advanced Bayesian methods for quantitative finance.

papers.title: Financial Markets as Non-equilibrium Systems
papers.description: Physics perspective on financial markets, order flow, and price formation.
papers.whyRead: Shows how physics thinking applies to finance. Very quantitative.

papers.title: Pricing Interest-Rate-Derivative Securities
papers.description: The Hull-White model for interest rate derivatives.
papers.whyRead: Standard model for interest rate derivatives pricing.

papers.title: Global Portfolio Optimization
papers.description: The Black-Litterman model for combining market equilibrium with investor views.
papers.whyRead: Industry standard for portfolio construction at institutional level.

papers.title: Autoregressive Conditional Heteroscedasticity
papers.description: The original ARCH model for volatility clustering.
papers.whyRead: Foundation of all GARCH models. Won Nobel Prize.

papers.title: Generalized Autoregressive Conditional Heteroskedasticity
papers.description: The GARCH(1,1) model that became the industry standard.
papers.whyRead: Most used volatility model in finance. Every quant knows this.

papers.title: Advances in Financial Machine Learning
papers.description: The definitive book on ML for finance. Walk-forward, meta-labeling, feature importance.
papers.whyRead: Best resource on avoiding ML pitfalls in finance. Every quant should read.
